talecon10.name: The Great Short Story Contest
talecon10.desc: A run of short tale contests, each on one prompt: Post-SCPocalypse, SCPs in War, Crackfiction, The Death of Alto Clef, Diary of an SCP, and Marshall, Carter and Dark Ltd.
talecon10.win: A different winner for each prompt.

1000.name: SCP-1000 Contest
1000.desc: The race for the SCP-1000 slot. Theme: folktales and urban legends.

hc2012.name: Halloween Contest 2012
hc2012.desc: Tales that bring the Foundation and an in-universe Halloween together.

nyc2013.name: New Years Canon Contest 2013
nyc2013.desc: Teams created new canons. Some of the wiki's most popular canons began here.
nyc2013.win: "The Unfounded Canon" by DrClef, Fantem, Photosynthetic and Pig_catapult.

tc2013.name: Time Contest
tc2013.desc: How existing SCPs would fare with the passage of time.

2000.name: SCP-2000 Contest
2000.desc: The race for the SCP-2000 slot. Theme: science fiction.

uac2014.name: Under-Appreciated Contest
uac2014.desc: Tales written to put overlooked articles in the spotlight.
uac2014.win: "Exit History" by HammerMaiden and "Exploded Diagram of a Young Woman" by Chubert.

af2014.name: April Fools 2014
af2014.desc: Not a contest: the wiki's April Fools' joke for 2014. The site became "Super Cute Pets", with a cutesy front page and joke SCP-CU entries.

goi2014.name: Groups of Interest Contest 2014
goi2014.desc: A team contest to invent new Groups of Interest. Several of the best known ones started here.
goi2014.win: "Serpent's Hand" by thedeadlymoose, Dexanote, Vivax and Zyn.

rei2015.name: Reimagining Contest
rei2015.desc: Some of the oldest and most classic articles were given a makeover for new readers.

sc2015.name: Short Works Contest
sc2015.desc: The best article in the fewest words.

mtf2016.name: Mobile Task Force Contest
mtf2016.desc: A team contest about the Foundation's Mobile Task Forces.
mtf2016.win: Team Basic ("Kappa-10"): LurkD, djkaktus, Harmony and Doctor Cimmerian.

af2016.name: Crack Fiction Contest
af2016.desc: An April Fools' contest for deliberately ridiculous "crack fiction".
af2016.win: Six winners, listed on the contest page.

d-con2016.name: D-Class Contest
d-con2016.desc: Stories giving a new dimension to D-class, the test subjects in orange jumpsuits.
d-con2016.win: SCP-2439 by Jack Ike, SCP-2669 by Kalinin and "History" by Humanmale.

hiscon2017.name: This Contest Is History!
hiscon2017.desc: SCP entries and tales about the history of the world.
hiscon2017.win: SCP-2624 by TyGently and "Now Hollow Fires Burn Out To Black And Lights Are Guttering Low" by Doctor Cimmerian.

3000.name: SCP-3000 Contest
3000.desc: The race for the SCP-3000 slot. Theme: horror.
3000.win: SCP-3000 (Anantashesha) by A Random Day, djkaktus and Joreth.

173fest.name: 10 Years Birthday SCParty
173fest.desc: A festival for the tenth birthday of SCP-173, the wiki's first article, with pieces about the statue.

jam-con2018.name: 72 Hour Jam Contest
jam-con2018.desc: Three articles written and posted back to back, with 24 hours for each.

doomsday2018.name: Doomsday Contest
doomsday2018.desc: Teams of authors worked out the most bombastic ways to end the world.
doomsday2018.win: Team Clever Gentlemen: Weryllium, CadaverCommander, Modern_Erasmus and fieldstone.

4000.name: SCP-4000 Contest
4000.desc: The race for the SCP-4000 slot as Series 5 opened. Theme: history.

halloween2018.name: Halloween Contest 2018
halloween2018.desc: A seasonal contest celebrating the tropes and clichés of Halloween.

cliche2019.name: Cliché-Con 2019
cliche2019.desc: Authors took a list of the site's most common clichés and subverted them, or played them straight.
cliche2019.win: SCP-4205 by Woedenaz, SCP-3597 by aismallard, and SCP-4511 by DrAnnoyingDog and Rounderhouse.

goi2019.name: International GoI Contest 2019
goi2019.desc: An unofficial team contest hosted by the International Translation Archive, around the Groups of Interest of the wiki's branches in other languages.

jam-con2019.name: 144-Hour Jam Contest
jam-con2019.desc: The jam contest again, with 48 hours for each of three articles. Themes: shaggy dogs, pulp fiction and dreams.

collab-con2019.name: Collaboration Contest
collab-con2019.desc: A contest for pairs of authors writing together.
collab-con2019.win: Three pairs: KindlyTurtleClem and Lt Flops, notgull and Mew-ltiverse, Ihp and Uncle Nicolini.

5000.name: SCP-5000 Contest
5000.desc: The race for the SCP-5000 slot. Theme: mystery.

jam-con2020.name: 144-Hour Jam Contest Two
jam-con2020.desc: The third jam contest. Themes: "explosions", "delicious" and "more than meets the eye".

exquisite-corpse2020.name: Exquisite Corpse Contest
exquisite-corpse2020.desc: Authors were handed containment procedures and an object class written by someone else.

canon2020.name: Canon Renaissance Contest
canon2020.desc: A second team contest for new canons, held after many canons from the 2013 contest had gone quiet.
canon2020.win: "The Man In The White Suit" by Rounderhouse, Captain Kirby, Tufto and Woedenaz.

cupid2021.name: Cupid Contest 2021
cupid2021.win: SCP-5659 by Ralliston, "This Cruel Moon" by The_Spider_Queen and "Critter Profile: Max!" by R4_EX.

jam-con2021.name: JamCon 2021
jam-con2021.desc: The jam contest again. Themes: "marine", "corruption" and "what could possibly go wrong?".

6000.name: SCP-6000 Contest
6000.desc: The race for the SCP-6000 slot. Theme: nature.
6000.win: SCP-6000 (The Serpent, the Moose, and the Wanderer's Library) by Rounderhouse.

memecon2021-unofficial.name: MEMECON
memecon2021-unofficial.desc: An unofficial contest to bring some humour back to the wiki by playing off favourite memes.
memecon2021-unofficial.win: SCP-6599 by J Dune and PlaguePJP.

nightmarefest.name: NIGHTMAREFEST
nightmarefest.desc: An unofficial festival celebrating the spookiest articles, in three features.
nightmarefest.win: SCP-6274 by Rounderhouse, SCP-6061 by Ecronak and SCP-6502 by bigslothonmyface.

departmentcon2022.name: Department-Con 2022
departmentcon2022.desc: Teams wrote about the Foundation's lesser-known departments.
departmentcon2022.win: The Fire Suppression Department team: Uncle Nicolini, UraniumEmpire and T Rutherford.

7000.name: SCP-7000 Contest
7000.desc: The race for the SCP-7000 slot. Theme: luck.

halloweencon2022.name: Halloweencon 2022
halloweencon2022.desc: A prose and art contest for Halloween.
halloweencon2022.win: "Makeup" by J Dune (writing) and "Site-19 Security Data 19.2022.10.31" by IronShears (art).

coldpostcon.name: ColdpostCon
coldpostcon.desc: A winter contest for fast writing, posted without any outside critique.
coldpostcon.win: SCP-7311 by Rounderhouse and "The Nuclear Option" by Captain Kirby.

romcon2023-unofficial.name: RomCon
romcon2023-unofficial.desc: An unofficial romance-themed knockout tournament of tales with original characters.
romcon2023-unofficial.win: Rounderhouse, with the Agent Calendar tales.

goblincon2023.name: GoblinCon
goblincon2023.desc: A contest to fill the "goblin slots": SCP numbers that technical issues had kept blocked.
goblincon2023.win: Five category winners, listed on the contest page.

lorecon2023.name: LoreCon 2023
lorecon2023.desc: "The Mighty Lore and Aesthetics Contest", run for the international branch: each entry combines a piece of SCP lore with an assigned aesthetic.

remixcon2023.name: RemixCon 2023
remixcon2023.desc: Remixes of existing articles, old or new, in the spirit of the 2015 Reimagining Contest.
remixcon2023.win: Five category winners, listed on the contest page.

8000.name: SCP-8000 Contest
8000.desc: The race for the SCP-8000 slot. Theme: fantasy.
8000.win: SCP-8000 (The Seal of Approval) by PlaguePJP.

pridefest2024.name: Pridefest 2024
pridefest2024.desc: A month-long festival of writing and art in solidarity with the wiki's LGBTQIA+ authors. A festival, not a contest: no winners.

wrathcon2024.name: WRATHCON
wrathcon2024.desc: A contest themed on evil, where only the winner remains.
wrathcon2024.win: "Live Camera Feed of Site-69, where Everything is Fine" by Croquembouche.

spook-nico-2024-unofficial.name: Spook Nico 2024
spook-nico-2024-unofficial.desc: A small unofficial contest held in October 2024. I could not find a contest page for it on the wiki.

publicdomaincon2025.name: Public Domain Con
publicdomaincon2025.desc: Teams brought characters from the public domain back to life in the SCP universe.
publicdomaincon2025.win: Team "Provisional Government of Occupied Third Law, Revolutionary Firing Squad": TyGently, Intercedent and Anorrack.

intcanoncon2025.name: International Canon Contest
intcanoncon2025.desc: An unofficial contest organised by the International Translation Archive. Each team wrote for a canon from another language branch of the wiki.
intcanoncon2025.win: "The Delilahs" by Uncle Nicolini, Guaire, Lemonsense and Diogene_s.

pridefest2025.name: Pridefest 2025
pridefest2025.desc: The second Pridefest. Suggested theme: "Rise Up: Pride in Protest". A festival, not a contest: no winners.

classiccon2025.name: Classic Con
classiccon2025.desc: Back to basics: SCP entries only, 1,000 words at most, no tricks with the format.
classiccon2025.win: SCP-8557 ("Again, Narcissus?") by local lesbian commie.

9000.name: SCP-9000 Contest
9000.desc: The race for the SCP-9000 slot. Theme: "Structures, Constructs, Pattern".

dumbcon2026-unofficial.name: Dumbcon
dumbcon2026-unofficial.desc: An unofficial contest. Each participant handed in one bad or dumb idea, which went at random to someone else to write as an SCP entry.

timjc2026-unofficial.name: This Is My JamCon
timjc2026-unofficial.desc: An unofficial music-themed event. Authors swapped favourite songs and turned the one they received into an article.

sportscon2026.name: SPORTSCON
sportscon2026.desc: Every entry, whether SCP, tale or GoI format, must be about a sport.

pridefest2026.name: Pridefest 2026
pridefest2026.desc: The third Pridefest, now an official yearly event. Suggested theme: "For All of Us". A festival, not a contest: no winners.

goicon-2026.name: Groups of Interest Contest 2026
goicon-2026.desc: Teams of up to three wrote tales and GoI formats about any Groups of Interest. No SCP entries, and the Foundation could not be directly involved.
